activity_summary: The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short, and she would not cut another. You ate, and you left the desk upstairs. Less from the clove is still not a cure. The reckoning is at five.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate the soft of the loaf, and left the pages on the desk.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the thumb, and would not have a second loaf.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Put the rest under the cloth.

entities.name: a penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A penny, and five of the clock

facets.activity: Ate three bites with Mistress Ansell and Alse

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is a penny. It is a full thumb short of the notch.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A penny is the whole of the business on this board.
